name: Tanja: Drama heeft een Voornaam
overview: From relationship therapy with her husband Michael, the conflict with her mother-in-law, her sister's battle with cancer, the public humiliations, and the open wounds from all the men who cheated on her: we witness the ups and downs of Tanja Dexters' life from the front row. As a (stay-at-home) mother, wife, daughter, sister, step-mom, and friend. But we also celebrate. We celebrate the tumultuous renewal of her wedding vows in an intimate setting in Durbuy, and in luxurious Marbella, we get a taste of the jet-set life she leads with her blended family. And in between? She shows us her bank account, we sit beside her in court as she mediates with her ex, until no one can deny it anymore: drama has only one first name.
